posts.title: Huckleberry Hound (1960)
posts.description: This is a "minor" child's space book. It is a fictional story about Huckleberry Hound and his friends who decide to build a rocket. It is an almost "standard" story of they never really take off for the Moon but convince themselves that this strange place they found is on the Moon. posts.title: Bleep and Booster Annual (1966)
posts.description: Bleep and Booster was a beloved children's animated sci-fi series featured on the BBC's Blue Peter from 1963 to 1977. For 1966-1968 there was a yearly annual album with adventures of the duo. I love space art in general and feel that images of children exploring space are important in helping them imagine people (and themselves) in space and the possibilities.
